plugins.name: borrow-before-build
plugins.description: Before building anything non-trivial from scratch, the agent checks your codebase and searches for open-source prior art, then shows its receipts.

plugins.name: clean-invisible-unicode
plugins.description: Finds and removes invisible or deceptive Unicode (zero-width, bidi/Trojan Source, tag-character and variation-selector payloads, blank-glyph identifiers) while keeping emoji and complex scripts intact.
